name: bella
description: BELLA, a token-first, accessibility-first design system. DTCG tokens, light and dark, agent-readable.

scripts.audit:visual: storybook build --quiet && concurrently -k -s first -n sb,test "http-server storybook-static -p 6006 --silent" "wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:6006 && test-storybook --url http://127.0.0.1:6006 && node scripts/audit-quality-docs.mjs http://127.0.0.1:6006"
scripts.gate: npm run build && git diff --exit-code tokens/bella.css tokens/bella.json docs/bella.css docs/tokens.md .storybook/theme-values.json .storybook/public/favicon.svg && node scripts/contract-parity.mjs && npm run audit:visual

author: Elleta McDaniel
